claims.statement: Pinned draft conversion guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES with table/board item menus Convert to issue then repository selection. Destination must be exact owner/repository, not inferred from project ownership or default repository.

Conversion creates repository-owned issue from project draft, distinct from copying a view or adding existing issue. Source does not specify permissions, visibility impact, conversion reversibility, notification or retained field mapping.

Project draft access is not permission to publish its content into chosen repository. Proposed safe conversion requires destination audience/creation authority and content review; these safeguards are not implemented or source-mandated receipts.
Further-reading draft creation page remains separate evidence. No draft converted, issue created, accepted policy, rights clearance or native behavior asserted.

Pinned bulk editing guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and copies/pastes cell contents into multiple destinations in same field. It describes value writes, not harmless view configuration or independent acceptance.

Selection reusable permits shift-click range, drag or command/control clicks. Exact selected item/field IDs, filter scope and concurrent edits require explicit affected-value diff; UI range selection alone is not approval.

Blue handle appears only when source cell content can be copied; drag up/down copies same-field values to selected cells. Source does not define all supported field types, permission errors or partial-write handling.

Delete/Backspace clears same field for selected items, not project item deletion or repository issue deletion. Clearing applicable required value must not become passing absence or approved exception.

Bulk edit Undo notice is offered after change, but no retention duration, complete rollback or concurrent-safe restoration guarantee supplied. Button existence is not tested recovery receipt or substitute for prechange evidence.

Underlying issue fields may synchronize repository metadata as separately reviewed; this guide does not establish which all copied fields cause wider writes. No bulk values edited or undo executed; claims reference-only.
